articles.title: This Lego Spaceship Spins Just Like the Real Thing!
articles.summary: The new Lego Project Hail Mary set has a secret: a spinning stand that makes the crew module move in and out, just like the movie spaceship! At $99.99 with 830 pieces, it's smaller than expected but totally amaze.

articles.title: These Planets Are Fluffier Than Cotton Candy!
articles.summary: Two newly found planets are as big as Jupiter but as light as cotton candy. They orbit a star 1,113 light-years away and are the puffiest worlds ever discovered. Scientists call them superpuffs.

articles.title: How Dogs and Humans Have Been Changing Each Other for 15,000 Years
articles.summary: A new book explores how dogs evolved alongside humans for 15,000 years. From Arctic sled dogs to tiny Chihuahuas, dogs adapted to different climates and jobs — and even changed our genes too!
